questions.text: The least number which, when divided by 15,30 and 45, leaves a remainder of 8 in each case is:
Find the largest positive integer that will divide 216, 358 and 454 leaving remainder 9, 13 and 17, respectively.

The ratio of the incomes of Ram and Ganga is 3 : 4 and the ratio of their expenditures is 2 : 3. If each person saves ₹2,000, then what is the ratio of their total income together to their total expenditure together?
G invested ₹x in a scheme which gives 12% return. Finally, he received ₹12,000 more amount than the invested amount. How much money (in ₹) did he invest in the scheme?
A sum was invested on simple interest at a certain rate for 3 years. Had it been put at 5% higher rate, it would have fetched ₹270 more interest. The sum invested was:
Find the yearly rate of compound interest at which ₹2,400 amounts to ₹3,650.10 in a duration of 3 years.
A and B individually can finish a work in 15 and 20 days, respectively. If B starts the work on 1 October, and they work on alternate days, the work will be finished on:
The ratio of the numbers of boys and girls in a school is 6 : 5. If 25% of the boys and 36% of the girls are scholarship holders, then the percentage of students who DO NOT get scholarship is:
The average of two numbers is 24 and the average of three other numbers is 29. What is the average of these five numbers?
In the year 2001, the production of a factory decreased by 30%. But, in 2002, the production increased by 25%. What is the resulting change (increase or decrease) in production over these two years?
A shopkeeper marked his items with prices 65% more than their cost price and allowed a discount of 35%. Find the percentage of his profit.
